initial_prompt: I’m really overwhelmed and don’t see the point of anything. Please don’t give a long answer, just tell me something short that might help right now.

messages.content: I’m really overwhelmed and don’t see the point of anything. Please don’t give a long answer, just tell me something short that might help right now.

You matter more than your thoughts are telling you right now, and you don’t have to figure everything out today.

Two small things you can do *right now*:
1. Take 10 slow breaths, in through your nose, out through your mouth, counting each one.
2. Reach out to one person (text, call, or message) and just say: “Hey, I’m having a rough time and could use someone to talk to.”

If you’re feeling like you might hurt yourself or you’re in real danger, please get immediate, in‑person help: call your local emergency number or a crisis line, or go somewhere public and safe and tell someone you need help.
